label: D2 of a common a2->S2 trial after a rewarded common a2 trial, only in episode trials ~45-70
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition, the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1) and was itself a common a2 trial (a rewarded a2/S2 streak, mostly while S2 is good). It never fires on a1/S1, rare transitions, after an unrewarded trial, or at D1/GO. It is also strongly gated by absolute episode time: essentially all activity falls in episode trials ~40-70 (none before 39 or after 72), so it looks like a slowly drifting hidden-state component combined with the a2-reward-streak signal. Within a streak, magnitude is highest on the first qualifying trial and decays on later repeats (e.g. 1.00 then 0.50 then 0.25). Activity concentrates where value is 7.7-8.1. All variables are observed at D2 (no future variables). Precision is only ~0.5 because many in-window a2-streak D2 steps stay silent, mostly later repeats of a long streak.
